prompt: audit my implementation against the API contract docs - I want to know exactly what's implemented wrong, not just what's missing

assertions.text: Report explicitly distinguishes VIOLATIONS (wrong implementation) from MISSING (not yet built)
Report catches the success response wrapper violation: POST /api/shorten wraps data in { success, message, data } but API_CONTRACT.md shows bare JSON response
Report catches the error envelope violation: api-response.ts adds a success field that is not in the error contract
Report catches the global error handler shape violation: app.ts sends { success: false, error } instead of { error }
Report catches the health route try-catch violation
Report uses specific file:line citations for each violation
